headlines.title: Man Utd to resurrect Hall interest - Tuesday's gossip
headlines.description: Manchester United may struggle to prise defender Lewis Hall from Newcastle, Arsenal midfielder Martin Zubimendi is pondering his future, Chelsea eye a double swoop for Barcelona duo, plus more.

headlines.title: London City earn point in thrilling draw against Arsenal

headlines.title: Vinicius says transfer interest affected Real form
headlines.description: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr says he felt "truly overwhelmed" by transfer speculation in the summer.
